notes.title: Update coming soon!
notes.notes:
We got a lot of feedback on the game, thank you all for your support! 

Some of you mentioned the need for cloud support and progress reset.

We always listen and an update will be live soon. It will also feature minor graphics and performance improvements.  

We'll keep you posted! Thank you again!
